rows.text: takes dword `+0x28` of `rcx` with bit 31 cleared in a register (the field itself is not written) and, when `edx` is below that value (unsigned `jae`), calls the callee at `001EA380` + 0x21 with `rcx` = the address of qword `edx` (stride 8) of the array at qword `+0x30` and `rdx` = `r8`, then stores byte 1 at `+0xE8`; otherwise tail-jumps the callee at `001EA380` + 0x3B with the incoming `rcx` and `rdx` = `r8`

clears bit 19 of dword `+0xB0` of `rcx` (AND 0xFFF7FFFF), zeroes word `+0x88` and byte `+0xB0`, copies word `+0x8C` to `+0x8E`, stores word `+0x8C` plus 1 at `+0x8C` and `+0x90`, and stores byte 1 at `+0x9B` and `+0x9D`

takes `i` = the truncation of `((double)(xmm2 + the seventh (stack) float) - 30.0 (`01CEBC48`)) * 0.1000000015 (`01CEBBB0`)`, clamped to 0..7, and `p` = qword `rdx[i]`; with `s` the sixth (stack) argument it sets `pos` = trunc(`(float [p] - 16.0 (`01CEBC84`)) * s + (float)r9d - (float)(s >> 1)`) and, for each `k` from trunc(float `[p]`) up to but not including trunc(float `[p+4]`) (none when the start is not below the end), stores `xmm2` + float `[p + 8 + k*4]` into float `rcx[pos]` when `pos` is positive and the sum is greater (`comiss`), then adds `s` to `pos` and stops once `pos` is at least the fifth (stack) argument (signed); the first `pos` is not checked against that bound
